title: Turkey Confirms Mecca Pact Committee to Convene in Riyadh on October 5
detail: Turkey confirmed that the Mecca Pact committee will convene in Riyadh on October 5, marking a key diplomatic milestone for the defense alliance. The meeting signals continued momentum in the pact's institutional development. Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan, Defence Minister Yasar Guler and chief of the general staff Selcuk Bayraktaroglu are due to attend the strategic political and defence committee, with Saudi and Pakistani officials, to discuss regional developments and institutionalisation of the alliance.

media.caption: Turkey says Mecca pact committee to meet in Riyadh on October 5
